en: A sepia-toned portrait of a smiling young woman in staged studio lighting, wearing a folk-style dress with embroidered bodice and apron, braided hair, and a floral wreath on her head. She holds a thin branch or staff. The background is a neutral cloudy studio backdrop. White printed captions appear in the lower left and right corners, identifying the photographer/publisher in Dresden and the woman as Erika Wedekind in a role from 'Die Schönen von Fogaras.'
